lesson.little_fish.title: Little Fish
lesson.little_fish.summary: Turn an oval, two simple triangles and a tiny face into a cheerful fish, then bring it to life with color.
lesson.little_fish.step.body: Start with one soft oval for the fish body.
lesson.little_fish.help.body_hint: Make the oval wide like a smooth pebble lying on its side.
lesson.little_fish.step.tail_fin: Add a triangle tail at the back and a small fin on top.
lesson.little_fish.help.tail_fin_hint: Let both triangle shapes touch the body so the fish feels connected.
lesson.little_fish.step.face: Finish with one little eye and a tiny curved smile.
lesson.little_fish.help.face_hint: Keep the eye and smile near the front half of the fish.
lesson.little_fish.complete.drawing: Your Little Fish is ready to swim into some color!
lesson.little_fish.coloring.body: Choose any color you love and fill the fish body first.
lesson.little_fish.coloring.tail_fin: Now color both the tail and the fin. They can match or be completely different.
